name: _cookies.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_cookies.scss — the cookie-consent banner: fixed bottom bar with
//  backdrop blur, info link, and the accept/refuse buttons' animated
//  corner brackets. Always-dark surface (raw white text tokens).
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Cookie consent banner: fixed bottom bar.
.cookies {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 300;

  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: var(--z-cookies);

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  padding-top: var(--space-md);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-md);
  background: rgba($color-black, 0.94);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--space-lg));
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--space-lg));
  border-top: var(--space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.15);
  color: var(--color-white-raw); // Banner bg is always dark — raw white text token
  font-size: var(--space-lg);
  line-height: 1.5;
  box-shadow: 0 calc(-1 * var(--space-2xs)) var(--space-xl) rgba($color-black, 0.2);

  // Mobile: no backdrop-filter — extremely expensive on mobile GPUs.
  // Solid background looks identical and costs nothing.
  @media (max-width: $bk-768) {
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
    backdrop-filter: none;
    background: rgba($color-black, 0.98);
  }

  @include layout-768() {
    padding-top: var(--space-lg);
    padding-bottom: var(--space-lg);
    font-size: var(--space-lg);
  }

  &-info {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: to-rem(260);
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    opacity: 0.9;
    font-weight: 300;

    a {
      @extend %LK_LINK;

      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
      opacity: 0.8;
      transition:
        opacity 0.2s ease,
        border-bottom-color 0.3s ease;

      &:hover,
      &:focus-visible {
        opacity: 1;
      }
    }
  }

  &-buttons {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-sm);
    flex-shrink: 0;

    &-accept,
    &-refuse {
      @extend %RESETBTN;
      @extend %TTL_BASE;
      @extend %TTL_XS;

      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: var(--space-pixel);
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
      padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-lg);
      color: rgba($color-white, 0.7); // Always light on always-dark banner bg
      background: transparent;
      transition:
        color 0.2s ease,
        background 0.2s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;

      // Animated corner borders
      &::before,
      &::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: var(--space-xs);
        height: var(--space-xs);
        transition:
          width 0.2s ease,
          height 0.2s ease;
      }

      &::before {
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        border-top: var(--space-hairline) solid currentColor;
        border-left: var(--space-hairline) solid currentColor;
      }

      &::after {
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        border-bottom: var(--space-hairline) solid currentColor;
        border-right: var(--space-hairline) solid currentColor;
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus {
        color: $color-white;

        &::before,
        &::after {
          width: calc(100% - var(--space-2xs));
          height: calc(100% - var(--space-2xs));
        }
      }

      // WebGPU corner-bracket overlay — the rust/corner-brackets canvas
      // repaints both L brackets once mounted inside the button; the
      // pseudo-element brackets drop out while the canvas is live.
      .cookies-buttons-canvas {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      &:has(> .cookies-buttons-canvas:not(.is-fallback))::before,
      &:has(> .cookies-buttons-canvas:not(.is-fallback))::after {
        content: none;
      }
    }
  }
}
